title: ConformalSAM: Unlocking the Potential of Foundational Segmentation Models in Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation with Conformal Prediction
mechanism: Calibrate a foundation teacher on the labelled data with conformal prediction, and keep as pseudo-labels only the pixels whose conformal set is a single class. Later training switches to self-reliance so the student does not overfit the FM masks.
adaptation: Teacher = our ensemble or the UniMatch V2 hybrid. Per-class conformal thresholds (crack and inactive separately) from val 54 + F51 give a coverage-controlled pool pseudo-label mask in place of hand-set thresholds. An add-on to the ensemble-distillation arm.
min_experiment: Ensemble-distillation arm B with conformal masks vs the same with plain soft targets. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.005 crack IoU and < +0.01 inactive IoU.
evidence: R: beats recent SSSS methods on three standard benchmarks and helps other methods as a plug-in (numbers not retrieved).
prior_overlap: Partial. Tolerant and threshold pseudo-label variants were run under Mean Teacher. Conformal calibration with an offline teacher was not run.

alt_notes.adaptation: Teacher = PF 5-seed ensemble or the DINOv3-IML model (SEEM has no EL concepts). Per-class quantiles fitted on val 54 + F51; pseudo-label the 1,152 half-cut pool cells; class-conditional selection keeps faint crack pixels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: student trained on labelled + CP-filtered pseudo-labelled half-cut cells, 5 seeds. Baseline: the old hard / tolerant pseudo-label runs with the pool at 100%. Metrics: E1 crack recall and relF1@2. Kill: no E1 relF1@2 gain over the old pseudo-label run.
